description: This file contains utility functions for resolving paths, checking the existence of control UI assets, and building the control UI assets in a project related to openclaw. It manages locating the control UI directory, verifying its build status, and triggering builds if necessary.

methods.name: resolveControlUiDistIndexPathForRoot
methods.description: Constructs the path to the control UI index.html based on a given root directory.

methods.name: resolveControlUiDistIndexHealth
methods.description: Checks if the control UI index.html exists at the expected location within a root directory.

methods.name: resolveControlUiRepoRoot
methods.description: Attempts to find the repository root directory containing the control UI configuration files.

methods.name: resolveControlUiDistIndexPath
methods.description: Resolves the path to the control UI index.html based on a given entry point or options.

methods.name: resolveControlUiRootOverrideSync
methods.description: Resolves a control UI root directory from a given override path, checking if it's a file or directory.

methods.name: resolveControlUiRootSync
methods.description: Determines the control UI root directory by checking various candidate locations.

methods.name: isPackageProvenControlUiRootSync
methods.description: Verifies if a given directory matches the expected control UI package root.

methods.name: summarizeCommandOutput
methods.description: Summarizes the last line of command output for display.

methods.name: ensureControlUiAssetsBuilt
methods.description: Ensures that the control UI assets are built and available, triggering a build if necessary.
